title: Specification Block Anatomy Explorer
description: An explorer that shows a MicroSim specification block as eight labeled bands (heading, type, sim-id, library, status, learning objective, body, implementation), runs a simulated regular-expression extraction that marks missing fields in red, and asks the learner to trace described generation defects back to the band that caused them.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Educational Technology
Instructional Design
AI-Assisted Content Generation
MicroSim Engineering

educational.audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners
educational.topic: Fields of a MicroSim specification block
learningObjectives: The learner will deconstruct a specification block into its fields and identify which field a given generation defect traces back to.
prerequisites: Writing a measurable objective with a Bloom level and verb
Choosing a MicroSim type and library
The sim-id as the MicroSim's directory name

dependencies: data.json (three example specifications and eight defects, loaded with fetch)

accessibility.screenReaderDescription: describe() explains the eight bands, the Extract button and the defect-tracing mode

controls.label: Extract
controls.action: Run a simulated extraction and list the fields found, with missing fields in red

controls.label: Show defects
controls.action: Show a described generation defect and ask which band caused it

controls.label: Next defect
controls.action: Show the next of eight defects (visible only with Show defects on)

controls.label: Band
controls.action: Highlight the band's extracted fields, or answer the defect question

assumptions: The extraction is a simplified stand-in for extract-sim-specs.py; field names mirror its output.
limitations: The numeric_values check only looks for digits in the body; it does not judge whether the numbers are sensible.

keyQuestions: Which field does each tool in the pipeline read?
What does the agent do when a field is missing?
Which field would you fix to remove a given defect?
commonMisconceptions: A clear description in the body can make up for a missing Bloom verb.
The agent will choose sensible slider ranges on its own.
Any heading level works as long as the block is inside a details element.
assessmentOpportunities: First-try accuracy on the eight defects
Rewriting the flawed fields of examples 2 and 3
